situation: Your friend is sitting next to you and keeps talking, but you want to focus on the lecture and take notes. What would you say to him?
answer: "Hey, I 'm really trying to focus on the lecture so I can take good notes. Would you mind saving the story for after class? Thanks. "

situation: You just told your friend that your exam is scheduled for 3 p.m. tomorrow afternoon. But you’ve just found out that you made a mistake—the exam is actually at 2 p.m. this afternoon. You need to call your friend immediately to correct this information. What would you say?
answer: "Hi, I need to correct something urgent about the exam. I told you it 's at 3 p.m. tomorrow, but that's wrong. I just found out it's actually at 2 p.m. today—so in just a few hours. Please ignore my earlier message and make sure you 're prepared for the earlier time. Sorry for the confusion and the short notice! "

title_en: Request to Switch Rooms for Debating Club
title_zh: 请求更换辩论俱乐部房
situation: You 're organizing a debating club, but the room you booked is too small. There happens to be a larger room next door, but there are students studying inside. If you want to switch rooms, what would you say to those students?
answer: Excuse me, dear fellow students. We booked this small room for our debating club, but it’s too cramped for our activity. We noticed your larger room next door. Would you mind switching rooms with us? We’ll help move your stuﬀ promptly and ensure no disturbance. We’d be extremely grateful for your kindness.

situation: You are on your way to campus to deliver a presentation when a fallen tree blocks the road, preventing you from arriving on time. You call your professor to ask if it would be possible to reschedule your presentation for later, or allow another student to present ﬁrst. What would you say?
answer: Hi professor, sorry to bother you. A fallen tree is blocking my way to campus, so I’ll be late for the presentation. Could I reschedule it to later, or let another student go ﬁrst? Thanks for your understanding!

situation: Your friend frequently skips classes, arrives late, leaves early, and does not submit assignments on time. What advice would you give them?
answer: Hey, I’m a bit worried about you skipping classes and missing deadlines. Try to set a daily schedule, attend lectures on time, and ﬁnish assignments step by step. Small changes will help you catch up soon!

situation: When you arrived at the usual classroom where you often have class, you saw a notice that said "Computer broken, need to move to a diﬀerent classroom. " However, because you were late today, by the time you got there, the other students had already moved to the other classroom. So you had to call a classmate and ask them to tell you how to get to the new classroom. What would you say?
answer: Hi, it 's Your Name. I 'm at our regular classroom and just saw the note saying we moved. Could you please tell me where the new classroom is? If you have a moment, could you also give me quick directions or the room number? Thank you!

situation: You have a deadline next week for a paper to submit, but your computer is broken, so you need more time to ﬁnish the paper. What would you say to your professor if you want to ask for a week 's extension?
answer: Hello Professor, I 'm writing to respectfully request a one-week extension for the upcoming paper. Unfortunately, my computer has broken down, which has delayed my progress signiﬁcantly. I am working to resolve the issue, but I would need a bit more time to complete the assignment properly. Would it be possible to submit it by next Friday? Thank you for your understanding.

situation: You are doing a weekend hiking trip with your friends. However, you 've noticed one of them are not wearing proper shoes that may lead to discomfort or injuries during the hike. What would you say to him?
answer: Hey, just wanted to check something with you. I noticed your shoes might not be the best ﬁt for the hike we have planned—some parts of the trail can be pretty rough or slippery. Wearing shoes with good grip and support could really help keep you comfortable and prevent any slips or injuries. Do you have a pair of hiking or sturdy sneakers you could bring along for safety?

situation: You think the food served in the school cafeteria is not healthy enough. You want to put forward some suggestions to the staﬀ to improve it. What would you say?
answer: Hello, I 'd like to share some feedback regarding the food options in the cafeteria. I believe there is room to make them healthier. It would be great if we could have more fresh fruits, vegetables, and whole-grain choices available daily. Oﬀering grilled or baked items instead of fried ones could also make a big diﬀerence. Thank you for considering my suggestions.

situation: You attended a lecture earlier today, but later realized that you lost the notebook where you had written all your notes. Your friend, who also attended the lecture, took very clear and detailed notes. You decide to ask her if she would be willing to lend you her notes to help you catch up. What would you say?
answer: Hi, I 'm really sorry to bother you, but I just realized I lost my notebook with all my notes from today 's lecture. I know you take really clear notes. Would it be possible to borrow yours so I can catch up? I 'll return them as soon as possible.

title_zh: 从图书馆切换到咖啡馆
situation: You arranged to go to the library with your friend to use the study room, but you just found out that the study room is double booked. You want to suggest meeting at a cafe instead. What would you say to your friend?
answer: Hi, I just found out the library study room is double booked. How about we meet at the cafe down the street? It’s cozy and perfect for our study session. Let me know if that works!

title_en: Give Speech Advice for a Friend
situation: Your friend is going to give a speech and feels really nervous about it. You want to give him/her some advice to calm down. What would you say to your friend?
answer: Hey, take it easy! Just focus on your speech content instead of the audience’s eyes. Breathe slowly before starting—it’ll calm your nerves. You’ve practiced a lot, so trust yourself. I’m sure you’ll do great!

situation: Your roommate Tom has agreed to be interviewed by you for a course assignment. However, he is out right now. You want to leave him a note to thank him, and also inform him that the interview will take place on Wednesday afternoon and last for about an hour. What would you say in the note?
answer: Hey Tom! I 'd like to express gratitude to you! Thanks much for agreeing to my interview for the course assignment. Just a reminder that the interview will be on Wednesday afternoon and will last for an hour. Please get prepared before the interview! See you then!

situation: You can 't ﬁnd your class notes, but you need them to ﬁnish your assignments. Your friend 's notes are very good. You want to borrow hers. How would you tell her?
answer: Hey, I’m in a bit of a bind , I can’t ﬁnd my class notes anywhere and I really need them to ﬁnish my assignment. I remember yours are always so clear and thorough. Would it be okay if I borrowed them for a day or two? I’ll take good care of them and get them back to you as soon as I’m done.

title_en: Borrow Friend’s Lecture Notes for Exam
situation: You missed the lecture last week and you know the information will be on the exam next week. Your friend takes very good notes during lectures. You want to get his notes from him so that you can use them to prepare. What do you say to him?
answer: Hi, I hope you 're doing well! I just realized I missed last week 's lecture, and I heard the content will be on next week 's exam. You always take such detailed notes in class, so I was wondering if I could borrow your notes to review? It would really help me prepare and make sure I don’t miss any key points. I can pick them up from you whenever it’s convenient, or you could send me a photo if that’s easier. Thanks so much—you’re a lifesaver!

situation: Your computer is broken and you can’t attend the online class. How should you tell your professor?
answer: Hi! I would like to discuss an issue we have encountered with my absence from the online class. The background is that my computer is broken and I can’t attend the online class. In the situation, what I can think of is to ask if you can share the class recording. Besides, another thing that comes to my mind is to consult you about the homework of the course.

situation: You’ve been given a deadline for an assignment, but due to a personal emergency, you need more time to ﬁnish it. How would you approach your professor to request an extension and ensure the situation is handled appropriately? What would you say?
answer: Professor, I 'm writing to respectfully request an extension for the assignment due on . A personal emergency has disrupted my schedule. Could I possibly submit it by ? This would allow me to deliver the quality work I aim for. Thank you for your consideration.

situation: You have to return a book to your friend, but when you get to school you realize you have forgotten to bring it. Your friend really needs it today. What will you say to your friend?
answer: Hey, I 'm so sorry, but I 've just realized that I forgot your book at home. I know you really need it today, so here 's what I can do: I can call my parents and see if they can bring it over during their lunch break. If that doesn 't work, I can quickly go home during the lunch break to get it for you. Again, I 'm really sorry about this.

situation: Your ﬂatmates are holding a party with loud music in their room at night, which is too noisy and inﬂuences your sleep, but you have an important exam early tomorrow morning. What should you say to them?
answer: Hi guys, I hope you 're having a great time at the party. It sounds really fun. However, I have a very important exam early tomorrow morning that I must be well-rested for. The loud music is making it impossible for me to sleep, and I 'm starting to feel quite anxious about my exam. So, I was wondering if you could possibly lower the volume of the music? That would help me a lot. Alternatively, if you could move the party to the common area, that might also work. I really appreciate your understanding. Thank you so much, and enjoy the rest of your night!

situation: You wrote an assignment, consulted your tutor, and asked them for some feedback on your work. What would you say to him?
answer: Hi sir, I’ve just ﬁnished drafting my assignment and was wondering if you could spare a moment to give me some feedback? I’d really value your thoughts on my structure and arguments to make sure I’m on the right track. Thanks so much for your help!

situation: Your ﬂatmate doesn 't follow the schedule to complete housework. What would you say to him or her?
answer: H, I noticed we agreed on a housework schedule earlier, but lately some tasks haven’t been done on time. Could we chat about it? Maybe adjust the schedule if it’s too tight-keeping things fair would make our place nicer for both of us.

situation: Your loan has been delayed, so you can 't pay the full amount of the accommodation fee at once. You have a part-time job, but it 's not enough. You are going to ask the university accommodation oﬃcer for advice. What will you say?
answer: Hello, I 'm writing because my student loan is delayed, so I cannot pay my full accommodation fee. I have a part-time job, but it 's insuﬃcient. Could you please advise me on a possible payment plan until my loan arrives?

situation: You lent a book to a classmate three weeks ago, and he hasn 't returned it yet. Now, you need the book very much. What would you say to him?
answer: Hey , I hope you’re doing well! I was wondering if you’ve ﬁnished reading the book I lent you three weeks ago. I need it for my studies now, so could you please return it when you get a chance? Thanks a lot!

situation: You are enrolled in Professor Miller 's History course. You 've missed the last three classes because you had to care for a sick family member. You haven 't been able to keep up with the readings or assignments. You approach Professor Miller after class to explain your situation. What would you say?
answer: Professor Miller, may I speak with you? I 've missed classes because I was caring for a sick family member. I apologize for falling behind and would appreciate guidance on catching up. Could you advise which readings and assignments are most critical? I 'm committed to making up the work.

situation: You are feeling overwhelmed by the upcoming ﬁnal exams and decide to seek advice from a senior student who has successfully navigated them before. You see them in the campus coﬀee shop, take a seat at their table, and introduce yourself. What would you say?
answer: Hi, I 'm Your Name, a second-year student. I 'm feeling quite overwhelmed by ﬁnals and heard you aced them last year. Would you have 10 minutes to share some study strategies? I 'd really appreciate any tips on time management or subject prioritization. Maybe we could chat over coﬀee?

situation: You are eating lunch in the university cafeteria. You take a bite of the chicken and realize it 's signiﬁcantly undercooked and still pink inside. You need to speak to one of the cafeteria staﬀ members about this issue. What would you say?

You are working on a research paper for one of your classes. You asked a classmate to read your draft and they gave you some helpful comments last week. Now, you see them in the library and want to let them know you appreciated their feedback. What would you say?
answer: Hi ! I just wanted to thank you again for reviewing my draft last week - your comments were incredibly helpful. I 've incorporated several of your suggestions and my paper is much stronger now. I really appreciate you taking the time to help me out. Let me know if I can ever return the favor!

title_zh: 报告无人值守的笔记本电脑
situation: You are in the library and notice a student has left their laptop unattended at a table. There are several people nearby, but you are concerned about the laptop 's security. You decide to report it to the security desk which is located near the entrance. What would you say?
answer: Excuse me, I wanted to report an unattended laptop on the second ﬂoor study area. It 's been left alone for over 15 minutes with no one nearby. I 'm concerned about its security but didn 't want to touch it myself. Could you please have someone check on it? Thank you for your help.

situation: You are in the university 's photography club, but you 've realized you 're overcommitted this semester with your coursework and a part-time job. You need to tell the club president, whom you see in the hallway, that you have to withdraw from the club. What do you say?
answer: Hi , I must regrettably resign from the club. Balancing studies and work has become overwhelming, and I can 't participate properly. I 've valued our time together and hope to rejoin when my schedule allows. Thank you for everything - I 'll return my equipment this week if needed.

situation: You are in the campus library working on an urgent assignment when your computer suddenly stops working. You try restarting it, but nothing happens. You see a staﬀ member nearby who might be able to help or direct you to someone who can. What would you say?
answer: Excuse me, I 'm working on an urgent assignment when my computer suddenly crashed and won 't restart. Could you please help me troubleshoot or direct me to tech support? I 'm worried about losing my work and meeting the deadline. I 'd really appreciate any immediate assistance you can provide.

situation: You are a student living in university accommodation, and the heater in your room has stopped working. It’s the middle of winter and your room is uncomfortably cold, especially at night. You go to the accommodation manager’s oﬃce to report the problem. What do you say to the accommodation manager?
answer: Excuse me, I need to report a broken heater in my room (Room 205). It 's been out since yesterday and the temperature is unbearable, especially at night. Could you please arrange for repairs as soon as possible? I 'd really appreciate your help with this urgent matter during this cold weather.

situation: You are in the student lounge when a classmate tells you they are struggling to keep up with assignments and often miss deadlines because they can 't manage their time. They seem frustrated and ask for your help. You remember you used to be disorganized too but have learned some strategies. What do you say to your classmate?
answer: I completely understand - I struggled with this too until I started using a planner and breaking tasks into smaller steps. Would you like to meet after class? I 'd be happy to share what worked for me, like prioritizing tasks and setting phone reminders. We could even study together!

situation: You are in your second year of university and studying business. You 're interested in ﬁnding an internship for the summer that’s related to your course. After class, you see your professor packing up her things and decide to ask her for some advice. What do you say?
answer: Excuse me, Professor? I 'm looking for a summer business internship to gain practical experience. Could you suggest companies that align with our course content or share tips for applications? I 'd really value your advice as someone familiar with industry expectations. Thank you for your time!

situation: You are working on a group presentation for class, and your teammates just decided on the order of presenters. They want you to go ﬁrst, but you feel unprepared and think it would be better to go later. You’re in a meeting with your group now. What do you say to your teammates?
answer: I 'm honored you 'd like me to present ﬁrst! To ensure our team makes the strongest start, would it be possible for me to go second or third? I 'd like to incorporate some key points from others ' presentations. Of course, if the group prefers me to begin, I 'll do my absolute best!

situation: You want to copy some documents, but you notice the printer is broken and the red light is ﬂashing. What would you say to the administrator?
answer: Excuse me, I 'm trying to print some documents, but the printer isn 't working - the red light is ﬂashing. Could you please help ﬁx it or direct me to another available printer? I 'd really appreciate your assistance. Thank you!

situation: You live with a ﬂat-mate. You have noticed that your ﬂat-mate often uses your desk and stationery when you are not at home. You are concerned about losing your notes and other important items. What would you say to your ﬂat-mate?
answer: Hey Name, I noticed you’ve been using my desk and stationery while I’m out. I don’t mind sharing sometimes, but I’m a bit worried about my notes and important things getting misplaced. Could we chat about setting some boundaries or sharing supplies in a way that works for both of us?

situation: You are in the library and want to use the photocopier, but it is not working because the red light is ﬂashing. You need to ask the library assistant to ﬁx it. What would you say?
answer: Excuse me, I was trying to use the photocopier, but it seems to be malfunctioning-the red light is ﬂashing, and it won’t start. I’m not sure if it needs a paper reﬁll, a toner replacement, or just a quick reset. Could you please take a look or guide me to another available copier? I’d really appreciate your help. Thank you!

situation: You are studying for an important exam in a quiet section of the library. A group of students nearby is speaking loudly, making it hard for you to concentrate. You notice a librarian at the help desk a few steps away. What would you say to the librarian?
answer: "Excuse me, I’m sorry to bother you—but there’s a group speaking loudly over by the windows. I’m studying for an exam and struggling to focus. Would it be possible to remind them about the quiet zone rules? Thank you for your help! "

situation: You are in the library studying for a very important exam. Your classmate invites you to a party this weekend, but you really need to focus on your studies. You want to politely decline their invitation without hurting their feelings. What would you say?
answer: "Thanks so much for inviting me! I’d love to hang out, but I’ve got a super important exam to study for this weekend. Can I take a rain check? I really need to crush this exam ﬁrst! "

situation: You are checking your grade for a recent assignment and you feel your work deserved a higher mark. After class, you approach your lecturer to talk about it. You would like them to review your paper again and explain how the grade was decided. What would you say?
answer: "Excuse me, Dr. Lee. I reviewed the feedback on Assignment 2 and was hoping you could help me understand how the grade was determined. I’d appreciate it if you could revisit my work—I want to make sure I meet expectations for future assignments. "

situation: You are working on an assignment for your history class, but you are confused about what the professor expects in one of the questions. You read the instructions several times but are still unsure how to approach it. After class, you decide to ask your professor to clarify. What would you say?
answer: "Excuse me, Professor. I’ve reviewed the instructions for Question 3, but I’m still unsure how to approach it. Could you please clarify what you’re looking for in the answer? Thank you! "

situation: You are chatting with a classmate after your language class. You’ve just found out about a fun language exchange event happening this weekend on campus. It’s a good opportunity to practice speaking with students from diﬀerent countries. You’d like to invite your classmate to come with you. What would you say?
answer: "Hey, I just found out about this fun language exchange event on campus this weekend. It’s a great chance to practice speaking with students from diﬀerent countries. Want to go together? "

situation: You are looking for a job at your university. One day, you see a notice about a job in the campus cafeteria. You meet the cafeteria manager. Ask them what kind of job it is and what you would need to do in this position.
answer: Hi there, I 'm a student here and saw the job notice posted in the cafeteria. Could you tell me what kind of position this is and what the main responsibilities would be? I’d love to learn more about what the role involves day-to-day.

situation: You are studying in the campus library. A group of students sitting near you are talking loudly and disturbing your concentration. What would you say to them to handle the situation politely? Please give your response as if you were speaking to them.
answer: Excuse me, I hope you don’t mind me mentioning this—I’m trying to study nearby and having a bit of trouble concentrating with the conversation volume. Would you be able to lower your voices or maybe move to a group study area? I’d really appreciate it!

situation: You are in class when you remember that you will be traveling overseas next week to attend a family event. You realize that you will miss one of your lectures and possibly an assignment deadline. After class, you approach your professor to inform them about your trip. What do you say to your professor?

You are a student and you keep getting locked out of your university account. You 've reset your password multiple times, but the problem persists. You call IT support to explain the situation and ask for a more permanent solution. What would you say?
answer: Hi, I 'm a student experiencing repeated account lockouts despite password resets. Could you investigate if there 's a system issue or provide a permanent solution? My student ID is [XYZ].

situation: You are a university student who scheduled an appointment to meet with your professor during oﬃce hours to ask for help with an assignment. However, you missed the meeting because you were stuck in traﬃc and couldn 't make it on time. You now see your professor in the hallway later that day. What would you say?
answer: "Professor, I sincerely apologize for missing our meeting - I got stuck in unexpected traﬃc. Could we possibly reschedule? I truly value your guidance on this assignment. "

situation: You are in the library working on a diﬃcult assignment. A classmate, who you know hasn 't started the work, approaches you and asks if they can copy your nearly completed assignment because they are out of time. You don 't want to give them your work. What would you say?
answer: Sorry, but I don 't share assignments - that 's against academic rules. I can explain some concepts if you want to quickly start yours? "

situation: You are scheduled to work in the biology lab next Tuesday at 10 am. However, you have a very important doctor 's appointment that day that you cannot reschedule. You need to ask your lab partner if they would be willing to switch lab times with you next week. What would you say?
answer: Hi [Name], I have a conﬂict with our Tuesday 10 am lab—I’ve got an unmissable doctor’s appointment. Would you be willing to switch lab times with me next week? I’d be happy to return the favor anytime!

situation: You are on your way to a group meeting in the library to prepare for an upcoming exam. However, you just received an urgent phone call from a family member and need to deal with it before joining the group. You know the meeting has already started. You call one of your classmates to let them know. What would you say?
answer: Hi [Name], I’m so sorry—I just got an urgent family call and need to handle it before heading to the library. I’ll be there as soon as I can, probably [estimate time, e.g., 20 minutes]. Could you ﬁll me in on what I miss? Really appreciate it!

situation: You are living in a student dorm and recently noticed that the refrigerator in your shared kitchen is not cooling properly. Some of your food has spoiled, and it 's becoming a real inconvenience. You decide to speak to the accommodation manager about the issue. What do you say to the accommodation manager?
answer: I’m sorry to bother you, but the shared fridge in our dorm has stopped cooling properly. Several students, including myself, have lost food because of this. Would it be possible to arrange a repair? We’d really appreciate your help.

situation: You are in the student center and realize you lost your headphones earlier today. You think you might have dropped them in the library or the cafeteria. You decide to go to the campus security oﬃce to see if someone turned them in. What do you say to the campus security oﬃcer?
answer: Hi, I think I lost my headphones earlier today—they might be in the library or cafeteria. Has anyone turned them in? They’re describe color/brand if needed. I’d really appreciate any help ﬁnding them.

situation: You share an apartment with a roommate and have both agreed to split the cleaning duties each week. Lately, you’ve noticed that your roommate hasn’t been doing their part, and it 's starting to bother you. You want to bring it up without starting an argument. You see your roommate in the kitchen. What would you say?
answer: "Hey [Roommate’s Name], could we check in about our cleaning schedule? I’ve noticed some tasks have been slipping lately, and I want to make sure we’re both on the same page. Maybe we could adjust the system if it’s not working for you?

situation: You are walking out of your lecture and realize you didn’t understand some of the main points your professor was making. You see a classmate who you think took good notes and paid attention during class. You want to ask them for help understanding what was covered. What would you say?
answer: "Hey [Name], I think you paid really good attention in class today. I missed a few of the main points—would you mind explaining them to me? I’d really appreciate it! "

situation: You are working on a group presentation for one of your classes. Each person was assigned a section to complete by the weekend. However, you were unable to ﬁnish your part because of a family emergency. You meet with your group the next day. What would you say to them?
answer: Hi everyone, I wanted to let you know that I wasn’t able to ﬁnish my part of the presentation because of an unexpected family emergency. I’m really sorry for the delay—I’ll get it done as soon as possible. If there’s anything I can do to make up for it or if you need me to adjust my section to ﬁt the timeline, just let me know.

situation: You are in your second year of university and have been working on a big assignment for your psychology class. Unfortunately, you’ve had the ﬂu for the past week and couldn’t concentrate or get much work done. You have a doctor’s note and feel a little better now. You go to your lecturer’s oﬃce to talk. What would you say?
answer: Hi [Lecturer’s Name], I’ve been working on the psychology assignment, but I came down with the ﬂu last week and couldn’t focus or make much progress. I have a doctor’s note here if needed. I’m feeling better now—would it be possible to get a short extension to ﬁnish the assignment properly?

situation: You bought a car last week. You want to start driving it to school but you need to buy a parking pass. You know your friend drives their car and parks on campus. You decide to ask your friend where you can get a parking pass, how much it is, and where you should park. What do you say?
answer: Hey [Friend 's Name], I just bought a car and plan to drive to school. I know you park on campus—could you tell me where to get a parking pass, how much it costs, and the best spot to park? Thanks!

situation: You chose to study on a politics course but you have changed your mind. You think a history course might be better but you 're not sure what the course includes. What do you say to your teacher to get some advice?
answer: Excuse me, I initially enrolled in the politics course but I 'm reconsidering. I think history might suit me better, but I 'm unsure about the course content. Could you please explain what topics the history course covers, how it 's assessed, and what career paths it prepares students for? I 'd like to compare before making my ﬁnal decision

situation: You have decided that you don 't want to take the course in Mechanical Engineering. Your friend has dropped a course recently. You want your friend to tell you the correct procedure to follow and when he deadline is for getting a tuition refund. What do you say?
answer: Hey! I’ve decided to drop Mechanical Engineering. Since you just withdrew from a course, could you tell me the exact steps—portal clicks, advisor form, anything else - and the ﬁnal deadline for a full tuition refund? I want to be sure I don’t miss any steps before the cut-oﬀ .

situation: One of your friends from school is going away to start university next week. She 's excited but sad to say goodbye. Some of you are discussing ideas for a present to give her new apartment. What would you suggest to them?
answer: How about a little "survival box "? Pack a cute mug, her favorite tea, instant noodles, a framed photo of the group, and a tiny plant. It’s cheap, ﬁts in any suitcase, and every sip or glance will remind her she’s loved.

situation: You are in a class at college. The two students sitting next to you keep talking to each other. You can 't hear anything your teacher is saying. What would you say to them?
answer: Excuse me, could you two keep it down a bit? I’m ﬁnding it hard to hear what the teacher is saying. Thanks a lot.

situation: You have a part time job at the university library. Your manager has asked you to work overtime on saturday, but you 'll miss the last bus home. Your friend has a car and might be able to help. What would you say to them?
answer: Hey [Friend 's Name], I hope you’re free to chat for a second. So, my library manager just asked if I can work overtime this Saturday—it’s a bit last minute, but they really need the help. The only issue is that by the time I ﬁnish, I’ll miss the last bus home. I know you have a car, and I was wondering if you’d be able to give me a lift back then? I totally get if you’re busy, but I’d really appreciate it. Let me know what works for you!

title_zh: 解决对汽车借用的担忧
situation: You 've lent your car to a friend for a weekend trip. Upon its return, you notice the interior is much dirtier than before. You need to discuss this with your friend to address the care of your property and the importance of respecting the agreements made. What would you say to your friend?
answer: Hey, I noticed the car 's interior is much dirtier than before. We agreed to keep it clean, and 'm a bit disappointed. l understand accidents happen, but l think it 's fair to ﬁnd a solution ,like sharing the cleaning cost or maybe you could take it for professional cleaning. This way, we respect our agreement and maintain our friendship

situation: You sign up for a photography lesson advertised as covering a wide range of techniques and oﬀering hands-on practice. However, when you attend the lesson, you ﬁnd that only basic topics are covered, and there 's minimal opportunity for practical application. How do you address this with the lesson organizer?
answer: Hi, l have some concerns about the photography lesson. title_zh: 寻求帮助修复笔记本电脑
situation: You are having problems with your laptop and you need it to do an assignment for your course. Your friend is good with computers and you are hoping to take your laptop to her apartment so she can ﬁx it. You want to leave a phone message for her. What would you say?
answer: Hi, it’s me! I’m reaching out because I’m in a bit of a bind—my laptop’s been acting up lately, and I really need it to ﬁnish a course assignment that’s coming up soon. I remember you’re great with computers, so I was wondering if you’d have some time to take a look at it? I can bring the laptop over to your apartment whenever works for you—just let me know what day or time is convenient. If you can help, that’d be such a lifesaver! You can call or text me back at xxx whenever you get this. Thanks so much, talk soon!

situation: You are interested in applying for a job in the school cafe. You know that boss is looking for someone with experience, which you are actually currently lacking. However, you are eager to learn and determined to work hard. What do you have to say to get this chance?
answer: Hello! I am really interested in the job at the school café . I know I don’t have experience yet, but I’m very eager to learn and willing to work hard. I’m quick to pick up new skills and I’m always ready to help. I’m sure I can be a great addition to your team. Please give me a chance!

title_en: Don't know about the new classroom
situation: The computer in the classroom broke down, so the professor moved the class to another room. However, you don 't know how to get to the new classroom and it 's already late. How should you call and ask your classmate for help?
answer: Hey [classmate’s name], I hope I’m not bothering you. The computer in our classroom broke down and we had to move. I’m running late and I don’t know how to get to the new room. Could you tell me where it is? I really appreciate your help.

situation: You book a spa day based on glowing reviews and a wide range of services listed online. When you arrive, half the services are unavailable, and the facilities are not as advertised. How do you address this with the spa manager?
answer: It was quite a letdown to see many services aren 't available and the facilities aren 't as great as I expected. I was looking forward to the full experience. To make up for this gap between what was advertised and what 's provided, could we maybe work out a partial refund or perhaps a voucher for a future visit when all services are back? I think that 'd be a fair way to ensure I still get the relaxing experience I was excited about.

situation: You need to change the meeting time with your colleague. How would you approach them to request a new time, and what key points should you cover including suggesting alternative times, considering their availability, and ensuring the rescheduling is convenient for both parties?
answer: Hey [colleague’s name], I hope you’re doing well. I need to change the meeting time we set up earlier. I know you’re busy, so I’ve checked my schedule and suggest we meet on [new date] at [new time]. Does that work for you? Let me know if there’s another time that’s more convenient. Thanks for your understanding!

situation: You and your friends have diﬀerent restaurant preferences for a night out. How should you approach the conversation to express your preference for a diﬀerent restaurant, and what points should you cover to reach a compromise that considers everyone 's opinions?
answer: Hey guys, I know we all have diﬀerent restaurant preferences. I was thinking we could try [my preferred restaurant]. It has a great menu that includes options for everyone’s tastes. Maybe we can share some dishes and try something new together? Let’s ﬁnd a place that makes everyone happy!

situation: You 've just arrived at the oﬃce and realized that it 's pouring rain outside. You didn 't bring an umbrella and know that one of your colleagues, who sits near you, often has a spare. How do you approach your colleague to ask for an umbrella, and what speciﬁc points do you include to ensure a positive response?
answer: Hey [colleague’s name], morning! I just realized it’s pouring rain outside and I didn’t bring an umbrella. I know you usually have a spare one. Would you mind if I borrow it? I’ll make sure to return it as soon as possible and keep it in good condition. I really appreciate your help!

situation: You are taking business night classes and your project is going to due soon. You want to ask your professor for an extension over the weekend. You go to the professor 's oﬃce. What do you say to him?
answer: Hello, Professor [Name]. I’m sorry to bother you, but I’m currently working on our project, and I’ve encountered some challenges that are taking longer than expected to resolve. I was wondering if it would be possible to get a short extension over the weekend. I’ll make sure to submit it as soon as possible and won’t let it aﬀect my other assignments. Thank you for your understanding!

situation: You are preparing dinner and your friend is calling you to discuss her daughter 's problem. You really want to help your friend solve her problem. But you are busy now, so you hope your friend could call you later. What do you say to your friend?
answer: Hey [friend’s name], I’m so glad you called. I really want to help with your daughter’s problem, but I’m in the middle of preparing dinner right now. Could we talk later? Maybe in an hour or so? I’ll be free then and can focus on what you need. Thanks for understanding!

situation: Your car has broken down, and you know a girl is waiting for you. How do you approach this situation to inform her of the delay and ask for assistance or suggest alternative arrangements? What speciﬁc details do you include to ensure clear communication and to propose a solution that accommodates both of your needs?
answer: I’d call her right away. I’d say my car broke down and I’m stuck. I’d ask if she could wait a bit longer or if we could meet at a halfway point. I’d also oﬀer to take a taxi to get there faster. I’ll keep her updated and apologize for the inconvenience.

situation: You are thirty minutes late for a 10 am. doctor's appointment. You need to explain to the receptionist and ask if the doctor could see you later today. what would you say to the receptionist?
answer: I’m really sorry I’m late. I had an unexpected traﬃc accident on the way. I understand it’s not ideal, but I’m already here. Could you please check if the doctor has any available time later today? I really need to see him. Thank you for your understanding.

situation: You 're leading a community book club, and during this month 's meeting, you discover several books are missing from the club 's library. You want to address the issue respectfully, reminding members to return books on time for everyone 's beneﬁt. What would you say to your members?
answer: Dear members, during this month 's meeting, we 've noticed that several books are missing from our club 's library. I kindly remind everyone to return the books on time. This way, we can ensure that all members have access to the books they want to read. Thank you for your cooperation!

situation: You 've been living in your apartment for a few years and feel that a fresh coat of paint would brighten up the space. You want to ask your landlord for permission to paint the walls yourself. How do you approach this conversation and what speciﬁc points do you bring up to get a positive response?
answer: Dear landlord, I’ve been living here happily for a few years. I think a fresh coat of paint would brighten up the apartment and make it more pleasant. I’d like to paint the walls myself using neutral colors. I’ll cover all ﬁxtures and clean up thoroughly. It’ll also keep the walls in good condition. Can I get your permission?

situation: You 're working on a group project with three other classmates and you have a deadline coming up soon. One of your group members has not contributed anything so far and is not responding to your messages. What would you say to your group member and your other teammates?
answer: To the unresponsive group member: Hey [Name], we’re all working hard on the project and the deadline is near. I noticed you haven’t contributed yet and haven’t replied to my messages. Is everything okay? Let’s catch up so we can ﬁgure out how to move forward together. To the other teammates: Hey guys, [Name] still hasn’t responded or contributed. We need to adjust our plan. Let’s divide the remaining tasks among us and make sure we can still meet the deadline.

situation: You 're responsible for a crucial part of a group project due in a week. You 've been waiting on important data from another group member, which they 've just informed you will be delayed. This setback aﬀects your ability to complete your section on time. What would you say to your group members?
answer: I know we 're tight on time with the presentation, but l heard you can 't ﬁnish your slides until Thursday. That 's cuting it realy close for us to review and practice together.Could you maybe prioritize geting the critical parts done ﬁrst, so we have something to work with earier? Or, if there 's a part of you workload we can redistribute to help speed things up. We need a solid plan to ensure we 're all prepped and ready for a great presentation.

title_en: Want to Go to Work with Colleague
situation: You are living in the same building with your colleague Mike, and you want to go to work with him every day and share the cost together. What would you say to him?
answer: Hey Mike, I was thinking, since we live in the same building and work at the same place, it would be great if we could go to work together every day. We can share the cost of transportation and maybe even save some time. What do you think?

situation: You are the captain of a community sports team and have provided team equipment for everyone 's use. After a few weeks, you notice that the equipment is often left outside, not stored properly, and some items are starting to show wear and tear much faster than expected. What would you say to your team?
answer: Hey team, l 've noticed our equipment isn 't being put away properly and it 's wearing out faster than it should. lt's crucial we all pitch in to take care of what we share. Let's make sure to store everything correctly after use and check for any damage. Mav be we can set up a quick equipment check at the end of practice? This way, we ensure everything lasts longer and is ready for us whenever we need it. Thanks for understanding and helping out.

title_en: Arriving 10 Minutes Late for a Meeting
situation: You are late by 10 minutes for a meeting due to a broken car and heavy traﬃc. How do you approach your colleagues or boss to explain your delay? What key points should you mention?
answer: I apologize for being 10 minutes late. My car broke down on the way, and the traﬃc was extremely heavy. I tried to ﬁnd another route but couldn’t. I understand the importance of punctuality and will take measures to avoid this in the future. Thank you for your understanding.

situation: You have an assignment due next week. Now you are in the library, but someone next to you is playing a video without headphones. You are too distracted to focus your study. You should have a conversation with him to make sure you have a quiet place. What would you say?
answer: Excuse me, I hope you don’t mind, but I’m having a bit of trouble focusing on my assignment because of the video sound. I understand you might be enjoying it, but could you please use headphones or lower the volume? I really need a quiet environment to study. Thank you so much for understanding.

situation: You are eating in a restaurant, and you order a hamburger, but are served ﬁsh and chips. what would you say to the waiter?
answer: Excuse me, I think there might be a mix-up with my order. I ordered a hamburger, but I was served ﬁsh and chips. Could you please check and see if it’s possible to get the hamburger I ordered? I’m really looking forward to it. Thank you for your help.

situation: You bought chips at a supermarket with a discount of 2 for 3 dollars, but when you checked out you found a mistake and you were charged for 3 dollars each. What would you say to the cashier?
answer: Excuse me, I think there might be a mistake with my purchase. I bought the chips with the “2 for 3 dollars” discount, but it looks like I was charged 3 dollars for each bag. Could you please check the transaction and correct it? I appreciate your help.

situation: You rent an apartment and after you move in, you found there were lots of problems, such as broken heater. What would you say to your landlord?
answer: Dear landlord, I hope this message ﬁnds you well. After moving into the apartment, I’ve noticed several issues, including a broken heater. It’s quite cold, and I’m concerned about staying warm. Could you please arrange for someone to come and ﬁx it as soon as possible? Thank you for your understanding and prompt attention to this matter.

title_en: Not into Coﬀee or Light Meals
situation: You have a dinner date with a friend, and she wants to go to a cafe where only serves coﬀee, tea, etc. You want to eat in a restaurant with a lot of foods. What do you say to your friend?
answer: Hey, I’m really looking forward to our dinner date! I was hoping we could go to a restaurant instead of just the café . I’m feeling pretty hungry and would love to have a full meal with lots of options. How about we try that new Italian place downtown? It has great reviews!

situation: You are going to eat outside with your friends and they want to eat Italian food. You don 't like Italian food, but want to dine out with them. What would you say to your friends?
answer: Hey guys, I’m really excited to go out with you! I know you all love Italian food, but to be honest, it’s not my favorite. Is there a chance we could try something else, like Asian cuisine or maybe a fusion restaurant? I’m sure we can ﬁnd something everyone will enjoy.

situation: You and your friends had dinner at a restaurant yesterday. You think you left a bag at the restaurant. You sat at the table next to the window and you have colleague 's thing inside the bag. You call the manager of the restaurant and what would you say to the manager?
answer: Hello, this is [Your Name]. I dined here yesterday and I think I left a bag at the table next to the window. It has my colleague’s things inside. Could you please check if it’s there? I really need it back. Thank you so much for your help.

situation: You are very interested in a lecture you just attended and want to learn more about other lectures, but you don 't know how to start. If you were to consult a teacher, what would you say?
answer: Hello [Teacher 's Name], I thoroughly enjoyed the lecture you gave today and I 'm eager to learn more. Could you recommend any other lectures or resources on this topic? I 'd love to expand my knowledge further. Thank you.

title_zh: 具有挑战性的课程建议
situation: I 've taken this course for one semester, but it 's quite diﬃcult. Now your friend tells you they also want to take this course and asks for your advice. Since the course is too diﬃcult, you do not recommend it. What should you say?
answer: Hey [Friend 's Name], I 've taken that course and found it quite challenging. I wouldn 't recommend it unless you 're up for a really tough workload. Maybe explore other courses that might be a better ﬁt for your schedule and interests.

title_en: Polite Decline for Birthday Party Due to Essay
title_zh: 因论文而礼貌地拒绝参加生日聚会
situation: Your friend is having a birthday party this weekend, and you have been invited. However, you need to complete an essay this weekend. How would you communicate to your friend that you cannot attend, in a way that does not make them feel sad and is polite?
answer: Hey [Friend 's Name], I 'm really excited about your birthday party this weekend, and I 'd love to be there to celebrate with you. Unfortunately, I have an essay that I absolutely need to ﬁnish by the end of the weekend, and I 'm afraid I won 't be able to make it. I hope you understand, and I promise to make it up to you soon. Have a fantastic birthday!

title_en: Aiding Injured Classmate with Library Return
situation: Your classmate 's leg is injured, but they need to return books to the library. You are planning to help them by returning the books. How would you communicate with your classmate and oﬀer your help?
answer: Hey [Classmate 's Name], I heard about your leg injury and that you need to return some books to the library. If it 's okay with you, I 'd be happy to help you out and take the books back for you. Let me know what time works best for you to drop them oﬀ .

situation: You forgot to bring the keys to your dorm, and the door is locked. You can 't get in. You need to call the school management team and ask them to solve this problem. What should you say?
answer: Hello, this is [Your Name] from [Dormitory Number]. I 've unfortunately locked myself out of my dorm and don 't have my keys with me. Could you please send someone to help me unlock the door? Thank you.

situation: Before you went on a trip, you borrowed a book from your classmate and promised to return it to him, but on the day of return, you opened your bag and found that the book was not there, and your classmate said that he would need the book today, what would you say to your classmate?
answer: Hey,I 'm really sorry, but I can 't seem to ﬁnd the book in my bag. I must have misplaced it. I know you need it today, and I feel terrible about not being able to return it as promised. I 'll do my best to ﬁnd it or replace it. Again, I apologize for the inconvenience.

title_en: Changing Course from Political Science to History
situation: You took a political science class, but you want to change it to a history class, but you don 't know the exact arrangement and content of the history class, and then you go to your teacher for help, what should you say?
answer: Hi , I 'm considering switching from the political science class to a history class, but I 'm not familiar with the course content or structure. Could you please provide me with some information about the history class? I 'd like to understand if it aligns with my interests and academic goals. Your guidance on this would be greatly appreciated.Thank you .

situation: You need a note to complete your assignment but you forgot to bring it. You want to borrow a note from your classmate because you know she has good notes and high grades, what would you tell her?
answer: Hey, I hope you 're doing well. I was hoping I could ask you a favor. I forgot to bring my notes for the assignment, and I know you always take great notes and do really well in the class. Would it be possible for me to borrow your notes from the last class? I would really appreciate it.Thanks a lot for considering it!

situation: The campus cafeteria is looking for part time jobs, they need someone with experience but you have no experience, how do you convince the restaurant manager?
answer: I may not have direct experience, but I am a quick learner and I 'm eager to gain new skills. I bring a strong work ethic, enthusiasm, and a positive attitude. I am conﬁdent that I can adapt quickly and contribute eﬀectively to the team. I am eager to prove myself and would appreciate the opportunity to learn and grow with your cafeteria. Thank you for considering me for the position.

situation: You 're looking for a part time job at a campus in cafeteria, you want to ask the manager if they have any vacancies and you want to know exactly what the job detail, What would you say to the manager?
answer: Hi there, I 'm interested in a part-time job at the campus cafeteria. I was wondering if there are any vacancies available at the moment? Also, I 'd like to know more about the job responsibilities and what the position entails. I 'm enthusiastic about joining the team and I 'm eager to learn more about the opportunities here.Thank you for your time.

title_en: Extension Request Due to Computer Malfunction
title_zh: 因计算机故障而请求延期
situation: Your computer suddenly malfunctioned and broke down, causing you to lose the essay that was originally saved on the computer. As a result, you are unable to submit the assignment on time. How would you request an extension for the assignment from your tutor in this situation?
answer: Hello , I hope you 're doing well. Unfortunately, my computer crashed, and I lost the essay I was working on. This has aﬀected my ability to submit the assignment on time. I would greatly appreciate it if you could grant me an extension to allow me to complete the assignment. I am taking immediate steps to rectify the situation, and I would be grateful for your consideration.Thank you.

situation: You are studying in a quiet study area, but there is a classmate playing videos out loud, which is causing you to be unable to study peacefully. How would you explain this situation to the classmate?
answer: Hey, I hope you 're doing well. I wanted to let you know that I 'm having trouble concentrating on my studies with the videos playing out loud. It 's kind of distracting, and I 'm trying to focus. Would you mind using headphones or lowering the volume? I would really appreciate it.Thank you.

title_en: Apologizing for Spilled Drink at Concert
title_zh: 为音乐会上洒出的饮料道
situation: You’re at a concert and accidentally spill your drink on the person sitting next to you. How would you apologize and oﬀer to help clean up the mess?
answer: I would immediately apologize to the person and oﬀer my assistance in cleaning up the mess. I would express my sincere regret for the accident and ask if there 's anything I can do to help, such as getting napkins or helping to dry the aﬀected areas. It 's important to take responsibility for the situation and show genuine concern for the person 's comfort.

title_en: Seeking Room Change or Cleaning Assistance
situation: You’re at a hotel and realize that your room is not as clean as expected, with stains on the carpet and dust on the furniture. How would you politely request a room change or ask for the issues to be addressed?
answer: I would politely approach the hotel staﬀ and express my concerns about the cleanliness of the room. I would mention the speciﬁc issues such as stains on the carpet and dust on the furniture, and politely request a room change or for the issues to be addressed. It 's important to communicate my concerns in a respectful manner and give the staﬀ the opportunity to resolve the situation to my satisfaction.

situation: You’re attending a networking event, and you want to approach someone you admire professionally to introduce yourself and start a conversation. How would you initiate the conversation and make a good impression?
answer: I would approach the person with a conﬁdent and friendly demeanor, and begin by introducing myself with a ﬁrm handshake, making eye contact, and sharing a genuine compliment about their work or achievements. I would then express my interest in their professional accomplishments, and ask open-ended questions to show curiosity and engage in a meaningful conversation. It 's important to be respectful of their time and attentive to their responses to make a positive impression.

title_en: Allergic Food Decline at Friend's Dinner
title_zh: 在朋友的晚餐上避免过敏
situation: You’re at a friend 's house for dinner, and they serve you a dish that you 're allergic to without realizing it. How would you politely decline the food without oﬀending your friend?
answer: I would politely and graciously inform my friend about my allergy and thank them for their kind gesture in preparing the meal. I would explain that unfortunately, I cannot eat the dish because of my allergy, but assure them that I appreciate their eﬀort and would be happy to enjoy other parts of the meal. It 's important to communicate this in a respectful and sincere manner to avoid oﬀending my friend.

situation: You’re attending a job interview and the interviewer asks you about your experience with a particular software program that you 're not familiar with. How would you respond?
answer: I would acknowledge that I am not familiar with the speciﬁc software program mentioned, but I would highlight my experience and proﬁciency with similar software programs. I would emphasize my ability and willingness to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and software tools. Additionally, I would express my enthusiasm for the opportunity to expand my skills and knowledge in that area.

situation: You’ve reserved a rental car for a weekend trip, but when you arrive at the rental agency, they inform you that they have overbooked and there are no cars available. How would you handle the situation?
answer: I would remain calm and ask the rental agency to assist me in ﬁnding an alternative solution. This could include helping me ﬁnd a rental car from another agency, providing transportation to another rental location, or oﬀering to compensate me for the inconvenience. I would also consider reaching out to other rental agencies or exploring other transportation options to ensure that my weekend trip is not disrupted.

situation: You plan to have dinner with your colleague and maybe later go to see a movie, but right now you feel sick. You have a headache and may have a cold. You see your colleague is having a coﬀee in the lunchroom. What should you say?
answer: Hey！ I hope you 're doing well. I just wanted to let you know that I 'm not feeling too great at the moment. I think I might be coming down with a cold or something. I was really looking forward to dinner and a movie tonight, but I don 't think I 'll be up for it. I 'm sorry to cancel on you last minute. Maybe we can reschedule for another time when I 'm feeling better. Thanks for understanding.

situation: You are 30 minutes late for your doctor’s appointment. You need to explain to the receptionist and ask if the doctor could see you later today.
answer: Hi, I 'm really sorry, but I got caught in traﬃc and I 'm running about 30 minutes late for my appointment with the doctor. Is there any chance I could still see the doctor later today? I understand if it 's not possible, but I would really appreciate it if you could check for me. Thank you so much for your help.

situation: You have an essay due tomorrow but you have been feeling sick for the past two weeks. You went to the clinic and got a doctor 's note. You feel better but have to ask your professor for an extension over the weekend. You go to your professor 's oﬃce. What do you say to him?
answer: Dear professor, I hope you 're doing well. I wanted to talk to you about the essay due tomorrow. Unfortunately, I 've been sick for the past two weeks and was under medical care. I 'm feeling better now, but the illness signiﬁcantly hindered my ability to work on the essay. I have a doctor 's note as proof of my situation, and I 'm ready to provide it if needed. Given these circumstances, I kindly request an extension over the weekend to complete my essay. I am committed to maintaining the quality of my work and appreciate your understanding and consideration in this matter. Thank you. RTS题目列表 - 155题 - Answer Key Sheet No answers available.
